info.name: Clients AR Account reports Inbox API

params.name: lastSynchronizationDate
params.description: Only documents collected on or after this ISO-8601 datetime are returned. Omit to return the whole current inbox.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of documents per page, between 1 and 100. Defaults to 100.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: The zero-based page index. Defaults to 0.

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to list the invoices and credit notes currently in the entity's inbox (documents awaiting OCR verification), each with a temporary download link to its attached file.
Any document that has an attached file is returned, whatever its type (PDF or image); a document with no attached file is excluded. Provide a last-synchronization date to pull only the documents collected since then.
